definitions.explanation: A sticky Japanese rice cake made from glutinous rice that has been pounded into a paste.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{餅|もち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We eat mochi at New Year's.

examples.japanese: {餅|もち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つく→つく：noentry⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of pounding mochi.

examples.english: Every year at the end of the year, the neighborhood gathers to pound mochi, and it's something I look forward to.

notes:
{餅|もち} is a traditional Japanese food made from glutinous rice (⟦{餅米|もちごめ}→もち米：10664_mochigome⟧) that is steamed and pounded.

TYPES:
- ⟦お{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧ (mochi soup eaten at New Year's)
- ⟦{草餅|くさもち}→草餅：15810_kusamochi⟧ (mugwort mochi)
- ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧ (mochi filled with sweet bean paste)
- ⟦{切|き}り{餅|もち}→切り餅：24896_kirimochi⟧ (pre-cut mochi squares)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {餅|もち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つく→つく：noentry⟧ (to pound mochi)
- {餅|もち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (to grill/toast mochi)
- {餅|もち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (mochi stretches)

SAFETY NOTE:
Every year in Japan, people (especially elderly) choke on mochi. It should be eaten carefully, in small pieces.
